module: Flowgraph node 'Return camera to vehicle' (once_instant category). Brings the camera back to the active vehicle from another mode (free camera, etc.) with commands.setGameCamera(). No pins.
notes: In the warning branch, 'logTag' is not defined in the file (nil global variable), so the log tag is nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: If a player vehicle exists, calls commands.setGameCamera(); otherwise logs a warning.
